title: Follow-up of Patients After 4-row Arthrodesis or Proximal Row Carpectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to follow-up on patients who underwent different types of wrist surgery: 4-row arthrodesis or proximal row carpectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients who underwent wrist surgery (4-row arthrodesis or proximal row carpectomy) between 1998 and 2004
